    v['sigma'] = sigma
    v['rho'] = rho
    v['beta'] = beta
    v['x'] = x
    v['y'] = y
    v['z'] = z
    return v

def legacy_step(v, i=0):
    h = v['h']
    sigma = v['sigma']
    rho = v['rho']
    beta = v['beta']
    x = v['x']
    y = v['y']
    z = v['z']
    dx = np.float32((sigma * (y - x)))
    dy = np.float32(((x * (rho - z)) - y))
    dz = np.float32(((x * y) - (beta * z)))
    x = np.float32((x + (h * dx)))
    y = np.float32((y + (h * dy)))

    v['sigma'] = sigma
    v['rho'] = rho
    v['beta'] = beta
    v['x'] = x
    v['y'] = y
    v['z'] = z
